title: deps: the minimatch OSV exemption (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) expires 2026-11-30 — renew it or move the last ^10 parents before the daily scan reds again
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTWPccNTuCwS1djJ86

Found-in #35108 (card thread, while measuring the daily Validate Dependencies scan for PR #35825). Filed at the seat's request; not dispatched.

## What happens on 2026-11-30

`osv-scanner.toml` carries one exemption, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (minimatch, the only patched version is the breaking 11.0.1), with `ignoreUntil = 2026-11-30`. The scanner still matches it on `main`: on merge base `cbc50a5a` the scan prints `GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 and 1 alias have been filtered out` (scanner v2.5.0, the workflow's pin). When the date passes, the scanner stops filtering it and the scheduled Validate Dependencies run goes red on `main` again, the same shape as #35108.

## Where the parents stand today (npm registry, newest versions)

The exemption's reason names seven parents that declared `^10`. Five of them now accept 11.x in their newest release:

| Parent | Newest | Declares minimatch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| eslint | 10.15.0 | ^11.0.5 |
| @eslint/config-array | 0.23.6 | ^11.0.5 |
| @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree | 8.73.0 | ^11.0.1 |
| @oclif/core | 5.1.12 | ^11.0.1 |
| readdir-glob | 4.0.0 (a major) | ^11.0.1 |
| @microsoft/api-extractor | 7.60.1 | 10.2.3 (exact) |
| typedoc | 0.28.20 | ^10.2.5 |

So the exemption cannot simply be deleted yet: api-extractor and typedoc still hold a 10.x copy.

## Done when

One of these lands before 2026-11-30, each in its own PR per the `osv-scanner.toml` header:

1. Renew: a new `ignoreUntil` (30-day default, 90 ceiling) with the `reason` rewritten to name only the parents that still block (today api-extractor and typedoc), labelled `osv-exemption`. Renewing accepts a known advisory again, so it is the same review as the original decision.
2. Remove: move the parents that allow it, check whether api-extractor and typedoc have a release accepting 11.x by then, and delete the exemption once no 10.x copy is left in `pnpm-lock.yaml` (`osv-scanner --lockfile=pnpm-lock.yaml` exits 0 with no filter line).

Either way the next scheduled Validate Dependencies run after 2026-11-30 is green.

Grade proposal: p2 (the seat's call), domain:devx. A red daily scan on `main` was graded p1 by precedent (#32386, #33211), so if this is not done before the date it becomes that.

Dedupe words: minimatch exemption, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, ignoreUntil, osv-scanner.toml renewal.
